roadmap.description: Reach player and class ranks to unlock Scout, Gunner, Engineer, Driller and their subclasses, then complete a dive with each.

roadmap.title: Character stats and gear
roadmap.description: Build max HP, speed, reload, crit, armor and level targets, and equip gear by rarity.

roadmap.title: Special dive modes
roadmap.description: Escort Duty, Anomaly, Vanguard and Lethal Operation dives.

roadmap.title: Creatures, resources and shop
roadmap.description: Boss and creature kills, gold and nitra totals, shop spending, drop pod and artifact goals.

roadmap.title: Damage, overclocks and weapon types

roadmap.title: Weapon level 18 and weapon masteries

roadmap.title: Endurance totals
roadmap.description: Lifetime dive, kill, damage, mining and step counters.

achievements.description: Unlock the Scout
achievements.summary: Unlock the Scout class, which is open from the start of a new save.

steps.text: Start a new save. The @mechanic{Scout} is already unlocked.

achievements.description: Unlock the Driller
achievements.summary: Unlock the Driller class by reaching player rank 7.

steps.text: Play dives until your player rank reaches 7. The @mechanic{Driller} unlocks at that rank.

achievements.description: Unlock the Engineer
achievements.summary: Unlock the Engineer class by reaching player rank 5.

steps.text: Play dives until your player rank reaches 5. The @mechanic{Engineer} unlocks at that rank.

achievements.description: Unlock the Gunner
achievements.summary: Unlock the Gunner class by reaching player rank 3.

steps.text: Play dives until your player rank reaches 3. The @mechanic{Gunner} unlocks at that rank.

achievements.description: Reach 75% crit chance
achievements.summary: Reach 75% critical hit chance.

guide.context: Each crit chance card gives 3%, 6%, 9%, 12% or 15%, from common to legendary rarity.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Jadiz} crit chance upgrades in the main menu before the dive.
At each level-up and shop visit, take crit chance cards, choosing the highest rarity offered.
A @mechanic{Sharp Shooter} Scout starts with +15% crit chance. Unlock it at Scout rank 18.

achievements.description: Reach 300 Max HP
achievements.summary: Reach 300 Max HP.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Bismor} Max HP upgrades in the main menu.
Take Max HP cards at level-ups and in the shop, especially the legendary 70.
Mine Red Sugar and take the @item{Red Sugar Cube} artifact from a supply pod if offered. Each Red Sugar then raises Max HP.

achievements.description: Reach 50% move speed
achievements.summary: Reach 50% move speed.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Umanite} move speed upgrades in the main menu.
Take move speed cards at each level-up, choosing the highest rarity offered.
A @mechanic{Recon} Scout gets a move speed bonus after each dodge. Unlock it at Scout rank 9.

achievements.description: Reach 75% reload speed
achievements.summary: Reach 75% reload speed.

guide.context: Pick the player-wide reload speed card, not the reload card for a single weapon.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Bismor} reload speed upgrades in the main menu.
Take the general reload speed card at each level-up, choosing the highest rarity offered.
A @mechanic{Recon} Scout gets a reload bonus after each dodge. Unlock it at Scout rank 9.

achievements.description: Collect 250 Gold
achievements.summary: Collect 250 Gold in total across dives.

steps.text: Mine gold ore, pop @enemy{Lootbugs}, and finish secondary objectives to collect Gold. The total carries between dives.

achievements.description: Collect 2,000 Nitra
achievements.summary: Collect 2,000 Nitra in total across dives.

guide.context: The Nitra Scanner is added after you collect 250 Nitra.

steps.text: Keep collecting Nitra from ore and @enemy{Lootbugs}. The total carries between dives.
Take the @item{Nitra Scanner} artifact from a supply pod. It lets you gain Nitra by mining plain rock.

achievements.description: Deal 250,000 Cryo damage
achievements.summary: Deal 250,000 Cryo (Cold) damage in total across dives.

steps.text: Use cold weapons in your dives, starting with the @item{Cryo Grenade}. The total carries between dives.

achievements.description: Deal 250,000 Fire damage
achievements.summary: Deal 250,000 Fire damage in total across dives.

steps.text: Use fire weapons in your dives, such as the @item{Incendiary Grenade} or @item{CRSPR Flamethrower}. The total carries between dives.

achievements.description: Dodge 100 times during a run
achievements.summary: Dodge 100 times in a single dive.

guide.context: Dodges from every stage of the dive add up.

steps.text: Play on Hazard 1 with a @mechanic{Recon} Scout. Recon has bonus dodge and unlocks at Scout rank 9.
Stand on cracked ground with exposed lava in @loc{Magma Core}. Each tick of damage gives a chance to dodge.
Stay in the same dive until you have 100 dodges.

achievements.description: Kill 15,000 enemies while standing still
achievements.summary: Kill 15,000 enemies while standing still, counted across all dives.

steps.text: Stay in one place and let turrets do the killing. The total carries between dives.
Avoid weapons that fire in a fixed direction, such as the @item{Lead Storm Powered Minigun}.

achievements.description: Spend 20,000 Gold
achievements.summary: Spend 20,000 Gold in total across dives.

steps.text: Spend your Gold in the shop between every stage. The total carries between dives.
Mine Gold fast, for example as the @mechanic{Driller}, so there is more to spend.

achievements.description: Take 2000 damage during a dive
achievements.summary: Take 2,000 damage in a single dive.

steps.text: Play a @mechanic{Gunner} dive in @loc{Magma Core}. Stand on lava ground to take small, steady damage.
Add Max HP and regeneration cards so you survive long enough to reach 2,000 damage taken.

achievements.description: Collect 250 Nitra
achievements.summary: Collect 250 Nitra in total across dives.

steps.text: Mine Nitra ore and pop @enemy{Lootbugs} to collect Nitra. The total carries between dives.

achievements.description: Deal over 1337 damage in one attack
achievements.summary: Deal more than 1,337 damage with a single attack.

steps.text: Use a weapon that fires one strong shot, such as the @item{M1000} or @item{Bulldog Heavy Revolver}.
Raise damage and crit damage until a single shot is over 1,337. This is easiest late in a dive.

achievements.description: Collect 2,000 Gold
achievements.summary: Collect 2,000 Gold in total across dives.

guide.context: The Gold Scanner is added after you collect 250 Gold.

steps.text: Keep collecting Gold from ore, @enemy{Lootbugs} and secondary objectives. The total carries between dives.
Take the @item{Gold Scanner} artifact from a supply pod. It lets you gain Gold by mining plain rock.

achievements.description: Kill the dreadnaught while you have less than 30 HP
achievements.summary: Kill the Dreadnought while your HP is below 30.

guide.context: The final boss is sometimes the Dreadnought Twins, so aim for a dive that ends with the single Dreadnought. Damage from turrets or damage over time that lands the kill also counts.

steps.text: Play a dive in @loc{Magma Core}, where lava ground ticks 1 damage.
Reach the final stage and break the cocoons to free the @enemy{Dreadnought}.
Stand on the cracked lava ground so your HP stays under 30 while you fight. Re-check your HP if you regenerate.
Kill the Dreadnought while your HP is below 30.

achievements.description: Die 3 times
achievements.summary: Die 3 times in total.

steps.text: Play dives and let enemies kill you, three times in all.

achievements.description: Reach 50 armor
achievements.summary: Reach 50 armor.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Croppa} armor upgrades in the main menu.
Take armor cards at every level-up and shop visit.
A @mechanic{Juggernaut} Gunner starts with extra armor. Unlock it at Gunner rank 9.

achievements.description: Reach level 50 during a dive
achievements.summary: Reach level 50 in a single dive.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Enor Pearl} XP gain upgrades in the main menu.
Take XP gain cards whenever they appear.
Use a biome mastery dive (win a biome dive on Hazard 3 first to unlock it). It has 10 stages instead of 5, so there is more time to level up.

achievements.description: Spend 2,500 Gold
achievements.summary: Spend 2,500 Gold in total across dives.

steps.text: Spend Gold in the shop between stages: stat cards, healing and rerolls. The total carries between dives.

achievements.description: Equip 10 Overclocks in a single dive
achievements.summary: Have 10 overclocks equipped at the same time in a single dive.

guide.context: A @mechanic{Tinkerer} Engineer starts weapons at level 3. Unlock it at Engineer rank 9.

steps.text: Play on Hazard 2 or higher, since Hazard 1 is often too short.
Take @item{Paint Job} cards so your weapons reach levels 6, 12 and 18 sooner. Each of those levels gives an overclock.
Pick an overclock each time one is offered, until you have 10.

achievements.description: Gain 1,000 level ups
achievements.summary: Gain 1,000 level-ups in total across dives.

steps.text: Keep playing dives. Every level-up counts, and the total carries between dives.
Pick XP gain cards and play long dives to level faster.

achievements.description: Fire 150,000 projectiles in a single dive
achievements.summary: Shoot 150,000 projectiles over the course of one dive.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks the moment you reach the count. A low Hazard keeps the dive from ending early.

steps.text: Finish a biome on Hazard 3 to unlock its biome mastery, which has 10 stages.
Start that biome mastery. Take fire rate and reload speed cards, and fast-firing weapons such as the @item{Zhukov NUK17}.
Keep firing until the count reaches 150,000. You do not need to finish the dive.

achievements.description: Do damage with 5 types in one dive
achievements.summary: Hit enemies with five damage types within one dive.

guide.context: Weapon examples: @item{DeepCore GK2} is Kinetic, @item{Cryo Grenade} is Cold, @item{Incendiary Grenade} is Fire, and @item{Nishanka Boltshark X-80} alternates Acid and Electrical.

steps.text: Take weapons of different damage types: Kinetic, Fire, Cold, Electrical, Acid or Plasma.
Keep one weapon of each of 5 types equipped and deal damage with each in the same dive.

achievements.description: Gain 10 mastery levels
achievements.summary: Gain 10 mastery levels in total from weapon, class mod and biome masteries.

steps.text: Finish a dive on Hazard 3 or higher in a biome, or with a class mod, to unlock its mastery.
Complete mastery dives. Each one gives mastery levels equal to its Hazard level, so higher Hazards add up faster.
Keep going until you have 10 mastery levels in total.

achievements.description: Collect 25 magnets
achievements.summary: Collect 25 magnets in total across dives.

steps.text: Kill enemies and pick up every magnet they drop. The total carries between dives.

achievements.description: Deal 2,500,000 Status Effect Damage in a single dive
achievements.summary: Inflict 2,500,000 status effect damage within one dive.

guide.context: Fire, Acid, Electrical and Cold damage all count, including damage added by overclocks.

steps.text: Bring weapons with Fire, Acid, Electrical or Cold damage. A @mechanic{Interrogator} Driller has bonus status damage. Unlock it at Driller rank 9.
Buy the @item{Magnite} status effect damage upgrades in the main menu.
Take status damage and potency cards in the dive.

achievements.description: Win a Crystalline Caverns Hazard 5 dive
achievements.summary: Win a Crystalline Caverns dive on Hazard 5.

guide.context: Mastery bonuses and meta upgrades both help. A Sharp Shooter Scout with the M1000 and crit upgrades is a workable build.

steps.text: Pick @loc{Crystalline Caverns} and set the dive to Hazard 5.
Clear every stage and defeat the final boss. The achievement unlocks when the dive is won.

achievements.description: Kill 3 Huuli Hoarders in one dive
achievements.summary: Kill three Huuli Hoarders within one dive.

guide.context: A normal dive shows only about one Huuli Hoarder. An artifact that spawns 4 of them also works.

steps.text: Finish a dive with any class mod on Hazard 3 to unlock that class mod's mastery.
Start the class mod mastery dive. Each stage spawns one @enemy{Huuli Hoarder}.
Kill the Huuli Hoarder on each of the first 3 stages.

achievements.description: Get 5 luck upgrades in one dive
achievements.summary: Pick 5 Luck upgrades in a single dive.

guide.context: Luck cards only appear at rare and epic rarity, so they are not on every level-up.

steps.text: Use a biome mastery dive (win a biome dive on Hazard 3 first to unlock it). It has more level-ups, so more chances to see a Luck card.
Take every Luck card that shows up until you have picked 5.

achievements.description: Land on 200 blocks in one dive
achievements.summary: Land on 200 rock blocks in a single dive.

guide.context: Pads show on the minimap.

steps.text: Play a dive in @loc{Azure Weald}.
Step on the @mechanic{Bio Jump Pads} and steer onto rocks so you land on them and break them.
Repeat until you have landed on 200 blocks in the same dive.

achievements.description: Heal 500 HP during one dive
achievements.summary: Heal 500 HP in a single dive.

steps.text: Play a low Hazard dive in @loc{Azure Weald}.
Take a little damage on purpose, then stand inside a circle of glowing crystals to heal.
Repeat in the same stage until you have healed 500 HP.

achievements.description: Destroy all rocks in one main mission stage
achievements.summary: Destroy every rock in a single main mission stage.

guide.context: Only main missions count. A throwable or turret overclock that breaks terrain also helps.

steps.text: Unlock the Driller at player rank 7, then pick a main mission with the @mechanic{Foreman} Driller on a low Hazard.
In the early stages, take mining speed, move speed, Max HP and armor cards.
On the last stage, mine every rock. Trees do not count.
Enter the drop pod after the stage is clear. The achievement unlocks then.

achievements.summary: Perform 50 rerolls during a single dive.

Reroll whenever you can: at a shop, on a level-up or at a supply pod. Keep count until you reach 50.
Rerolls at the shop cost less at first, so start there.

achievements.summary: Complete a dive without taking any overclocks.

Finish the dive.

achievements.displayName: The dwarf with the golden bug
achievements.description: Kill a golden lootbug
achievements.summary: Kill a golden lootbug.

steps.text: Keep playing dives until a golden @enemy{lootbug} appears.
Kill it.

achievements.description: Kill the Dreadnought without taking any damage
achievements.summary: Defeat the Dreadnought without being hurt at all during the fight.

steps.text: Keep your distance from the @enemy{Dreadnought}.
Walk circles around it so its attacks miss, and keep firing until it dies.

achievements.description: Kill the Dreadnought Twins before they can heal
achievements.summary: Kill both Dreadnought Twins before either one heals.

guide.context: The twins heal each other when their health bars get too uneven.

steps.text: Shoot both @enemy{Dreadnought Twins} evenly so their health stays close.
Kill them before either heals.

achievements.description: Kill a Q'ronar Shellback with the Supply Pod
achievements.summary: Defeat a Q'ronar Shellback by hitting it with the incoming supply pod.

guide.context: The Q'ronar Shellback only appears on Hazard 2 or higher. The supply pod can only be called after an area is cleared.

steps.text: Start a dive on Hazard 2 or higher and clear a supply pod area.
Wait until you fight the @enemy{Q'ronar Shellback}.
Call the @item{supply pod} once the Shellback stands in the middle of the landing area.

achievements.description: Kill all the lootbugs in a single dive
achievements.summary: Kill all the lootbugs in a single dive.

guide.context: Escort Duty dives cross the whole stage, so fewer lootbugs are missed.

steps.text: Play an Escort Duty dive so you cover each stage from start to finish.
Check corners and edges for @enemy{lootbugs} and kill every one.
Finish the dive.

achievements.description: Complete a dive without taking any damage
achievements.summary: Finish a dive from start to end without being hurt once.

steps.text: Play slowly and carefully, and avoid greedy fights.
Do this after you have many upgrades, good gear and unlocked masteries.
Finish the dive without being hit.

achievements.description: Complete a dive without spending any gold or nitra
achievements.summary: Finish a dive while spending no gold and no nitra.

steps.text: Pay nothing for shop upgrades, rerolls or healing.
Skip rerolls at level-ups and at the supply pod too.
Finish the dive.

achievements.description: Complete a dive with all of your weapons at level 1
achievements.summary: Finish a dive while every weapon you own is still level 1.

guide.context: A level-up can offer three weapon upgrades. Rerolling avoids them. Loot crates and Huuli Hoarder rewards cannot be rerolled.

steps.text: Save gold so you can reroll level-up choices.
Reroll whenever a level-up offers only weapon upgrades.
Avoid loot crates after stages and @enemy{Huuli Hoarders}.
Finish the dive.

achievements.description: Complete a dive with unstable overclocks on both the NUK17 and the BRT7
achievements.summary: Finish a dive holding the unstable overclock for both the NUK17 and the BRT7.

guide.context: The Recon can be offered both the NUK17 and the BRT7. The unstable overclock is offered at weapon level 18.

steps.text: Unlock the Scout Recon at Scout rank 9 and the Gunner @item{BRT7 Burst Fire Gun} at Gunner rank 3, then start a dive as the Recon with the @item{Zhukov NUK17}.
Put your upgrades into both weapons until each reaches level 18.
Pick each weapon's unstable overclock at level 18, then finish the dive.

achievements.description: Drill through a lootbug with B0b-33
achievements.summary: Run B0b-33's drill through a lootbug.

steps.text: During an Escort Duty dive, stop @npc{B0b-33} near some @enemy{lootbugs}.
When one walks in front of the drill, restart the drill.

achievements.description: Purchase every single meta upgrade
achievements.summary: Purchase every meta upgrade.

steps.text: Spend your earned currency in the meta upgrade menu until every upgrade is bought.

achievements.description: Enter the drop pod with more than 30 seconds remaining
achievements.summary: Board the drop pod while more than 30 seconds are still on its timer.

guide.context: Some gear adds time to the drop pod timer.

steps.text: Be ready at the drop pod when it is about to drop.
Step inside before the timer drops to 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Salvage 10 overclocks in a single dive
achievements.summary: Salvage ten overclocks within one dive.

guide.context: Each weapon offers overclocks at levels 6, 12 and 18. Salvage means taking the salvage option instead of an overclock.

steps.text: Level several weapons with weapon-specific upgrades.
At each overclock choice, pick the salvage option.
Repeat until you have salvaged 10 overclocks in the one dive.

achievements.description: Bounce 100 times in one stage
achievements.summary: Bounce 100 times in one stage.

guide.context: Jump pads have a short cooldown, so alternate between two pads.

steps.text: On any stage, find two jump pads close together.
Jump back and forth between them.
Use a turret build so enemies are handled while you bounce.

achievements.description: Have 3 'Tank Tracks' overclocks in a single dive
achievements.summary: Have 3 Tank Tracks overclocks in a single dive.

guide.context: Tank Tracks makes turrets follow you.

steps.text: Use turret weapons that offer Tank Tracks: Krakatoa Sentinel, LMG Gun Platform and Seismic Repulsor.
Level each one to its overclock choice and pick Tank Tracks.
Have all three picked in the same dive.

achievements.description: Have 50 turrets alive at the same time
achievements.summary: Have fifty turrets standing on the map together.

steps.text: Build a turret-focused loadout.
Place and keep turrets until 50 are alive at once.

achievements.description: Complete a dive with 4 (or more) of your weapons at the same level
achievements.summary: Complete a dive with at least 4 of your weapons at the same level.

steps.text: Reach the same level on four weapons, or stay at level 1 with all of them.
Finish the dive.

achievements.description: Have 5 scanner artifacts in a single dive
achievements.summary: Hold five scanner artifacts at once within one dive.

guide.context: The XP Scanner is there from the start.

steps.text: Collect 250 Gold in total to unlock the Gold Scanner, and 250 Nitra in total to unlock the Nitra Scanner.
Upgrade the Artifact Rerolls meta upgrade.
Take supply pod artifacts and reroll for scanners until you hold 5.

achievements.description: Have 3 'Sidearm' overclocks in a single dive
achievements.summary: Have 3 Sidearm overclocks in a single dive.

steps.text: Pick weapons that can take the Sidearm overclock. These are the Subata 120, the BRT7 Burst Fire Gun, the TH-0R Bug Taser, Thunderlash, the Twincoil Arc Burster, the Stubby Voltaic SMG and the Carrier Drone.
Pick Sidearm at the overclock choice on three of them.
Have all three in the same dive.

achievements.description: Reach max HP after having dropped below 5 HP
achievements.summary: Reach max HP after dropping below 5 HP.

guide.context: Healing crystals show on the minimap.

steps.text: Take damage until you are below 5 HP.
Stand inside the circle of healing crystals until your HP is full.

achievements.description: Reach level 30 with all 4 classes
achievements.summary: Get all four classes up to level 30.

steps.text: Play and level each of the four classes until each reaches level 30.

achievements.displayName: This is brilliant, but I like this
achievements.description: Have 2 'The Favourite' overlocks in a single dive
achievements.summary: Have 2 The Favourite overclocks in a single dive.

guide.context: The Favourite boosts one weapon and weakens the others.

steps.text: Use two weapons that offer The Favourite, such as Cryo Grenade, Proximity Mines or Lead Storm Powered Minigun.
Pick The Favourite at the overclock choice on both.
Have both in the same dive.

achievements.description: Fully fuel B0b-33
achievements.summary: Fully fuel B0b-33.

guide.context: Oil shale shows on the minimap.

steps.text: During an Escort Duty dive, collect oil shale across the stage.
Return it to @npc{B0b-33} until it is full.

achievements.description: Collect all the oil shale on one stage, then complete the dive
achievements.summary: Pick up every oil shale on a stage, then finish the dive.

guide.context: Oil shale shows on the minimap.

steps.text: On an Escort Duty dive, cover the whole stage and take every oil shale.
Take it to @npc{B0b-33}, then finish the dive.

achievements.displayName: The only drilldozer here is me
achievements.description: Mine an entire stage before moving B0b-33, then complete the dive
achievements.summary: Dig out every rock on a stage before B0b-33 is moved, then finish the dive.

steps.text: On an Escort Duty stage, mine out all the rock first.
Keep your distance from @npc{B0b-33} until you are done.
Then move B0b-33 and finish the dive.

achievements.description: Land on the drop pod ramp 3 times using jet boots
achievements.summary: Use jet boots to land on the drop pod ramp three times.

guide.context: The jet boots need 20 seconds to recharge.

steps.text: Open an early supply pod and take the @item{Jet Boots}, so the dive leaves more tries.
Jump onto the drop pod ramp, and do not use the boots just before the pod timer starts.
Land on the ramp 3 times.

achievements.displayName: Now, where did I put my keys?
achievements.description: Have the alien threat reach level 2 before moving B0b-33, then complete the dive
achievements.summary: Let the alien threat rise to level 2 before B0b-33 is moved, then finish the dive.

guide.context: Threat level shows in the top right.

steps.text: On an Escort Duty dive, clear the whole stage and leave @npc{B0b-33} where it is.
Check that threat level 2 is reached, then move B0b-33 and finish the dive.

achievements.description: Remember to Rock and Stone!
achievements.summary: Use the Rock and Stone call during a dive.

steps.text: During a dive, press V.
